s: Din ner habdala ubo k"a seipim: tzarik lebarek "bore meore haesh" bekol motzae shabbat al or hanner im yesh lo, abal im en lo ur bemotzae shabbat — en tzarik lechazzer acharayv kederek shetztzarik lechazzer achar shear mitzvot, lepi shello tiqqenu beraka zo ella lezeker shennibra haur bemotzae shabbat, shennatal adam harishon b' abanim vehiqqishan zo bezo veyatza mehen ur. Veap sheen mebarekim al shear kol haddebarim beshaa shennibreu, mikkol maqom haur kevan shenneesar beshabbat vehuttar bemotzae shabbat — hare zeh keillu nibra atta mechadash, umebarekim alayv bishat beriato:

Bammeh debarim amurim sheeno tzarik lechazzer acharayv? Bemotzae shabbatot, abal bemotzae yom hakkippurim apillu keshechal bechol — yesh omerim shetztzarik lechazzer achar birkat haur, lepi shehi kebirkat habdala, shemmebarek lehaqqadosh baruk hu shehibdil lanu zeh hayyom mishshear yom tob shenneesar bo lehabir ur ad atta ballayla:
Mi sheen lo kos lehabdil — tzarik lebarek al haur miyyad sheroeh (ayyen simman tqn"t), veken al habbesamim im yesh lo:

Mitzva min hammubchar lebarek al abuqa sheyyesh bah etzim harbeh umeorot harbeh, shehare mebarekim "bore meore haesh", leshon ribbuy meorot. Umikkol maqom, ap keshemmebarek al hanner — yebarek "bore meore haesh", sheharbeh gevanin yesh baur, shalhebet adumma, lebana viraqreqet. Vener shel shemen sheyyesh bah petilot harbeh doleqot — hare zo abuqa. Veap im en sham ella b' etzim doleqim yachad, veken b' petilot bener echad (im enan bishte piyyot hanner ella bepeh echad) — hare zo abuqa. Veken im (b' nerot shel shemen o shel shaava vecheleb meqorabim zeh lazeh ad sheorotehem medubbaqim yachad — hare zo abuqa, shehare yesh kan ribbuy meorot beyachad. Abal im en orotehem medubbaqim yachad — hare kol ner nechshab bipne atzmo ap al pi shehem meqorabim zeh lazeh, ella im ken) qala b' nerot shel shaava zeh al gabbe zeh vaasaan ner echad, (sheaz) dinam kaabuqa (ap im en orotehem medubbaqim yachad, kevan sheasaan keen gup echad — en kol echad nechshab bipne atzmo). Vetob lizzaher shello liqqach lehabdala abuqa meetzim sherechan ra (sheqqorin qi"n) im epshar beinyan acher, shehare bemotzae shabbat anu tzerikim lehashib nepesh bereach tob. Veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lehabdil al abuqa minnerot shel shaava, velo mishshear nerot, velo meetzim:

Im en lo abuqa — al kol panim yesh lo lemitzva min hammubchar lehadliq ner echad lehabdala chutz mehanner hammeyuchad lehair babbayit (im i epshar leqorbam kol kak zeh etzel zeh ad sheyyihyu orotehem medubbaqim yachad):

En mebarekim al haur ap al pi sheroehu ad sheyyihyeh samuk lo kol kak sheyyakol lehanot mimmennu kol kak lehishtammesh leoro ad sheyyukal lehakkir leoro ben matbea medina zo lematbea medina acheret. Venohagin lehistakkel betzippornayim, lirot sheyyukal lehanot leoro ulehakkir ben matbea lematbea kemo shemmakkir ben tzipporen lebasar, veod shehatztzippornayim hen simman beraka shehen parot verabot leolam. Veyesh lirot betzipporne yad yamin, veyeechoz hakkos bismolo, kemo shennitbaer besimman rtz"v. Venohagin lehistakkel bekappot hayyadayim sheyyesh besirtute hayyad simman lehitbarek bo. Veyesh likpop had' etzbaot al haagudal letok kap hayyad, sheaz roeh hatztzippornayim am hakkap bebat achat, veeno roeh az pene (hatztzippornayim) [haetzbaot] shebbipnim ella achorehem sheshsham hatztzippornayim. Veyesh nohagin lipshot achar kak had' etzbaot velirot meachorehem al hatztzippornayim:

En mebarekim al haur shello shabat beshabbat mimmeleket abera, kegon ner shehudlaq beshabbat en mebarekim alayv bemotzae shabbat, hoil venaasa meleekat habara beshabbat beur zeh baabera. Vaapillu hidliqo nokri letzorek atzmo, kevan sheim haya yisrael madliqo haya ober alayv — hare zo meleket abera. Veim abar uberak alayv — tzarik lachazor lebarek al ur sheshshabat im yesh lo. Abal im hidliqo nokri letzorek choleh sheen bo sakkana, o apillu yisrael letzorek chayya o shear choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana — en zo meleket abera umebarekim aleha bemotzae shabbat. Veken ashashit shehayeta doleqet veholeket meereb shabbat ad motzae shabbat — mebarekim aleha bemotzae shabbat, sheen zo meleket abera mah sheddolqa beshabbat, hoil vehudleqa behetter meereb shabbat:

En mebarekim al ur shel aboda zara, sheasur lehanot mittashmishe aboda zara, veap hanner haddoleq lepaneha asur lehanot leoro. Veap al pi shehabberaka hi al hashshalhebet veshalhebet en bah mammash veen issur aboda zara chal aleha bipne atzmah, mikkol maqom kol zeman shehashshalhebet qeshura begachelet shel aboda zara asur lehanot mimmenna mechamat issur haggachelet shehi qeshura bah, velaken en mebarekim aleha ap im shobta beshabbat, kegon shehudleqa bemotzae shabbat, lepi sheen mebarekim ella al ur sheyyukal lehanot mimmennu kemo shennitbaer. Veim abar uberak — tzarik lebarek al ur acher im yesh lo. Abal im yisrael hidliq ner shello minner shel aboda zara — mebarekin alayv, shemmuttar lehanot mimmennu ap al pi shehudlaq mishshalhebet shel aboda zara, shehashshalhebet en bo mammash. (Abal nokri shehidliq minner shel aboda zara — en mebarekin alayv mishshum gezera, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Lo aseru lebarek al ur shello shabat mimmeleket abera, dehaynu ner shehudlaq beshabbat, ella al oto ner atzmo, abal im hidliq yisrael mimmennu ner acher bemotzae shabbat — mebarekim alayv, sheap sheyyesh bener zeh ur mehanner harishon shello shabat — mikkol maqom yesh bo tosepet shel hetter, dehaynu mah shehaur mittosep meelayv behadlaqat hashsheni bemotzae shabbat shehu zeman hetter, vahare hu mebarek al hattosepet shel hetter. Abal oto ner atzmo shehudlaq beshabbat — en mebarekin alayv bemotzae shabbat, apillu leachar zeman merubbeh shekkebar nittosep bo harbeh ur bizman hetter, mishshum gezera shemma yabou lebarek al ammud rishon shel haur shello shabat, dehaynu bitziat hashshabbat miyyad, sheadayin lo nittosep kelum al ammud harishon sheddalaq berega shellipne yetziat hashshabbat. Abal bener shehidliq mimmennu yisrael bemotzae shabbat, apillu hidliqo bemotzae shabbat miyyad — en ligzor im nattir lebarek alayv shemma yitu lebarek al ner harishon shello shabat, lepi shessetam ner shello shabat lo hudlaq beshabbat al yede yisrael ella al yede nokri, umippene shennattir lebarek al ner shehidliq yisrael — lo yitu lebarek al ner shehidliq nokri, sheyyisrael benokri eno mitchallep. Abal nokri shehidliq ner bemotzae shabbat — en mebarekim alayv ella im ken hidliqo miyyisrael, abal im hidliqo minnokri acher — en mebarekim alayv, gezera shemma yabou lebarek al ner shehidliq nokri beshabbat, vibareku alayv bemotzae shabbat miyyad qodem sheyyittosep haur shel hetter. Abal kesheur zeh shel nokri shemmebarek alayv ba miyyisrael, ap al pi sheggam hayyisrael hidliq minnokri, kol sheyyad hayyisrael baemtza — en ligzor mishshum ammud harishon shel ner shehudlaq beshabbat. Vekol shekken im yad yisrael bitchillato, shehayyisrael hu shehotzi haur meetzim vaabanim bemotzae shabbat, o shehidliqo meur haddoleq meereb shabbat o miggechalim shehubaru meereb shabbat, shemmebarekim al ner shehidliq hannokri mimmennu:

Veim nokri hotzi ur bemotzae shabbat meetzim vaabanim o meur vegechalim shemmeereb shabbat, o meur shehudlaq beshabbat behetter — en mebarekim al orot ellu beatzman. Abal im hidliq hannokri mehem ner acher — mebarekim alayv. (Veyesh omerim behepek, sheal ner zeh en mebarekim alayv, sheggazeru al kol ner shehidliq nokri bemotzae shabbat shello miyyisrael mishshum ner shehidliqo beshabbat, abal al oto ur atzmo shehotzi hannokri bemotzae shabbat meetzim vaabanim o miggechalim — lo gazeru alayv kelal. Veyesh lachush ledibre shenehem, sheyyadliq yisrael ner meur zeh o minner zeh, vibarek alayv ledibre hakkol):

Im abar uberak al ner shehidliq nokri minnokri — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kevan sheen asur ella mishshum gezera. Vehu haddin bener shehudlaq beshabbat, im berak alayv bemotzae shabbat leachar shennittosep bo ur shel hetter, sheen issuro ella mishshum gezera:
Nokrim shehidliqu ner lipnehem, ap al pi shehidliquhu miyyisrael — en mebarekim alayv, shessetam mesibbat nokrim laaboda zara, vahare zeh kener shel aboda zara:

Haya holek chutz lakkerak veraa ur, im rob anshe hakkerak nokrim — eno mebarek alayv, shemmin hassetam hu ur shel nokri shello hidliq miyyisrael. Veim rob yisrael, o apillu mechetza al mechetza — mebarek alayv im hu yakol lehanot kan leoro lehakkir ben matbea lematbea:

Ur shehotziuhu bemotzae shabbat meetzim vaabanim, ap al pi shello shabat beshabbat, shennibra atta mechadash — mebarekim alayv, shehare en mebarekim al haur ella lezeker shennibra haur bemotzae shabbat meabanim shehiqqishan adam harishon zo bezo. Abal bemotzae yom hakkippurim en mebarekin ella al haur sheshshabat mammash, velo apillu al ner shehidliq yisrael minnokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman trk"d:

Gechalim habboarot kol kak sheillu maknis qisam benehen hu nidlaq — mebarekim alehem. Vehu sheasuyin kede lehair, abal im asuyin kede lehitchammem kenegdan — en mebarekin alehem, sheapillu al hanner en mebarekin im eno asuy lehair, kemo sheyyitbaer:
Ur shel kibshan bitchillat serepat hallebenim — en mebarekim alayv, sheaz eno asuy lehair. Abal achar shennisrepa — az asuy lehair, umebarekim alayv:

Ner shel bet hakkeneset, bimehem hayu mebarekim alayv lipamim, im haya adam chashub mitareach etzlam bebet hakkeneset, sheaz hanner naaseh lehair lo, o im shammash hakkeneset okel bacheder hassamuk lebet hakkeneset shechallonotayv petuchim lebet hakkeneset, shennaaseh hanner lehair lo im en hallebana meira lo shamma. Abal im lo haya sham adam chashub velo shammash haokel sham veyesh ner doleq sham — lo hayu mebarekin alayv, shello naasa lehair ella likbod shekina. Lepikak, akshav sheen lanu orechim bebet hakkeneset velo shammash haokel sham — en mebarekim al ner shebbebet hakkeneset. (Veod, sheakshav darkenu lehadliq bebet hakkeneset apillu bayyom bishbil kebod shekina, ulepikak ap im madliqim ballayla gam bishbil lehair — en mebarekim alayv, hoil veap bayyom hayu madliqim oto). (Abal im marbim nerot ballayla yoter mibbayyom bishbil lehair — mebarekim alehem):

En mebarekim al ner shel met keshemmotziim oto liqbura bemotzae shabbat, im hu met chashub sheillu hayu meqabberim oto bayyom hayu gam ken motziim ner lepanayv likbodo, shennimtza ner zeh shemmotziim lepanayv bemotzae shabbat eno asuy bishbil lehair bilbad, kevan sheap bayyom hayu motziim lepanayv. Abal met sheeno chashub kol kak lehotzi lepanayv ner keshehayu meqabberim oto bayyom — mebarekim al hanner shehotzi lepanayv ballayla, shehu asuy bishbil lehair bilbad:

Suma lo yebarek al hanner bemotzae shabbat, shehare en mebarekin al hanner apillu kesheroeh oto ella kesheyyukal lehanot meoro kol kak ad sheyyukal lehakkir ben matbea lematbea, ella yabdil belo birkat hanner:

Hayu yoshebim bebet hakkeneset bemotzae shabbat vehebiu lahem ur — lo yebareku alayv kol echad veechad bipne atzmo, ella echad mebarek vekullam shomeim veyotzeim yede chobatan. Veap al pi sheim haya kol echad mebarek bipne atzmo lo hayu mebattelim kol kak millimmudam kemo akshav shetztzerikim lebattel ad sheyyishtequ kullam veyishmeu, mikkol maqom akshav yesh hiddur yoter, ki "berob am hadrat melek":

Haya ner tamun becheqo, ap al pi shehu beyado — eno mebarek alayv, kevan shehu tamun veeno yakol liroto ulehakkir ben matbea lematbea leoro im lo yotziennu mecheqo. Vaapillu ner sheyyakol lehakkir ben matbea lematbea leoro ella sheeno yakol lirot et hashshalhebet, kegon shehanner omed beqeren zavit vehu omed min hatztzad qetzat beinyan sheeno roeh hashshalhebet, ap al pi sheyyakol lehishtammesh leorah — lo yebarek ad sheyyukal lirot hashshalhebet. Veim hanner hu baashashit sheyyakol lirot hashshalhebet mittok dopne haashashit — yakol lebarek alayv. (Veyesh choleqim):
